title: Americans Will See Right Through Trump's $5,000 Offer, Rahm Emanuel Says
description:
Rahm Emanuel, former White House chief of staff and former US ambassador to Japan, reacts to President Donald Trump’s proposal of a $5,000 payment tied to a Republican win in the midterms, saying "this dog won't hunt." Emanuel argues that both President Trump and Democrats want the election to be a referendum on Trump, but said Republicans are framing it as a test of Trump’s record and leadership. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on "Balance of Power."
